APP_NAME.description: The name of your Auth service (e.g., 'My Company Auth').

BASE_URL.description: The full URL of this worker (e.g., https://auth.mydomain.com).

COOKIE_DOMAIN.description: The root domain for SSO cookies (e.g., .mydomain.com). Use 'localhost' for local dev.

RESEND_DOMAIN.description: Your verified domain in Resend for sending emails (e.g., mail.mydomain.com).

ADMIN_SECRET.description: (Optional) Secret key used to authorize API requests from your Admin Dashboard.

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: (Optional) GitHub OAuth Client ID. Leave empty to disable GitHub login.

GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: (Optional) GitHub OAuth Client Secret. Leave empty to disable GitHub login.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: (Optional) Google OAuth Client ID. Leave empty to disable Google login.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: (Optional) Google OAuth Client Secret. Leave empty to disable Google login.
